CONSENTS.NOTE: Your decision is recorded immediately and can no longer be erased. Withdrawing your consent closes your record to caregivers from the next request on. A caregiver can still open it in an emergency: that is declared, justified, time-limited, and you are told.
CONSENTS.RGPD_ERR: Your request could not be sent.
CONSENTS.RGPD_EXPLAIN_ACCES: You will receive a list of what the platform holds about you. You can already see who accessed your record, further down this page.
CONSENTS.RGPD_EXPLAIN_EFFACEMENT: Before you send this: a care record cannot be deleted. The law requires it to be kept for a set period, and the record of who accessed it must remain — that is what protects you. What is possible is to anonymise your identity: your name disappears, the medical record stays but can no longer be linked to you. The administration will tell you what it can do in your case.
CONSENTS.RGPD_EXPLAIN_LIMITATION: The use in question is paused while your challenge is examined.
CONSENTS.RGPD_EXPLAIN_OPPOSITION: Say which use you object to. Some processing is necessary for your care and cannot be stopped; the administration will tell you.
CONSENTS.RGPD_EXPLAIN_PORTABILITE: You will receive your data in a reusable format that you can hand to another facility.
CONSENTS.RGPD_EXPLAIN_RECTIFICATION: Say precisely what is wrong and what should replace it. Clinical data is not corrected without the clinician who recorded it.
CONSENTS.RGPD_NOTE: You can ask to see, correct, retrieve or erase your data. Your request goes to the platform administration, which answers you in writing within 30 days. Nothing happens automatically.
CONSENTS.RGPD_PRECISION_HINT: Write it in your own words. The person handling your request will read it.
CONSENTS.RGPD_PRECISION_WHY: At least 10 characters: without this, we cannot tell what to correct.
CONSENTS.RGPD_SENT: Request recorded. You will receive an answer by {{date}} at the latest.

CONSENTS.RGPD_TYPE_ACCES: See what you hold about me

SETTINGS.TITLE: Platform Settings
SETTINGS.SUBTITLE: Configure global rules, security and system behavior.
SETTINGS.BILLING_DESC: Accepted payment methods and financial settings.
SETTINGS.PAY_CASH_SUB: Accept in-person payments at the counter.
SETTINGS.PAY_OM_SUB: Direct integration with the Orange Money Guinea API.
SETTINGS.PAY_MOMO_SUB: Direct integration with the MTN Mobile Money API.
SETTINGS.2FA_SUB: Enforced for every professional account (doctors, pharmacists, CHWs, administrators) at each login. Patients are exempt.
SETTINGS.CONSENT_TITLE: Care consents granted when a record is created
SETTINGS.CONSENT_SUB: Automatically grants "medical record access" and "SMS reminders" to each new patient. FHIR export and anonymised research always remain the patient's choice, and each consent can be withdrawn from their space.
SETTINGS.EBOLA_WARNING: Any detection triggers an immediate national emergency.
SETTINGS.AI_ENABLE_SUB: Allows the CHW space to call the triage assistant. When disabled, the server rejects the evaluation.
SETTINGS.OFFLINE_MODE_SUB: Allows CHWs to record entries without network; they are replayed automatically when the connection returns. When disabled, any offline entry is rejected.
SETTINGS.SYNC_FREQ_HINT: Interval at which the CHW space pushes its local queue and pulls server changes while connected.
SETTINGS.USSD_TIMEOUT_HINT: Delay before the menu expires on basic phones.
SETTINGS.PRESCRIPTION_DESC: Rules applied to every prescription issued on the platform. They are regulatory: a prescription presented after its validity period is refused at the pharmacy.
SETTINGS.PRESCRIPTION_VALIDITY_HINT: Counted from the prescriber's signature, not from drafting.
SETTINGS.PRESCRIPTION_CODE_HINT: Code given to the patient and checked at the counter. Longer is safer but harder to copy.
SETTINGS.PRESCRIPTION_REG_HINT: Narcotics and psychotropics. Always shorter, and a doctor's signature is required regardless.
SETTINGS.PRESCRIPTION_RENEW_HINT: Cap on what a prescriber may grant. A controlled product is never renewable.
SETTINGS.PRESCRIPTION_SIGN_SUB: Pending regulatory decision (D2). When off, a prescription written by a community health worker can be dispensed as soon as the consultation is closed. When on, a doctor must validate it first - which blocks dispensing where there is no doctor.
SETTINGS.STRUCTURES_HINT: Each facility's profile (name, type, address) is managed from the Facilities page.
SETTINGS.MARGE_HINT: Applied to the national reference price when a pharmacist adds a medication to stock without entering a margin.
SETTINGS.IDENTITY_DESC: Name, logo and contact details shown everywhere: public site, sign-in pages, e-mails, SMS and documents. Change them here, never in the code.
SETTINGS.IDENTITY_LOGO_HINT: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, 2 MB max. Transparent background recommended.
SETTINGS.IDENTITY_LOGO_NONE: No logo: the name is shown alone.
SETTINGS.IDENTITY_NOM_COURT_HINT: No accents, 20 characters max. Empty = derived from the name (e.g. KENEYA).
SETTINGS.IDENTITY_EMAIL_EXPEDITEUR_HINT: Empty = platform name. The sending address stays the one configured on the server.
SETTINGS.IDENTITY_COPYRIGHT_HINT: Empty = "© year Name — All rights reserved".
SETTINGS.PHARMACIE_DESC: Till rules. They apply to every pharmacy on the platform.
SETTINGS.PHARMACIE_REMISE_HINT: Cap as a percentage of the total. Without a cap, a typo brings a sale to zero with nothing to stop it.
SETTINGS.PHARMACIE_CATEGORIES_DESC: In addition to controlled products, which always require one (EF-05-12). Still pending a decision: leaving everything off means only controlled products require a prescription.

IDENTITES.VERIFIEE_MSG: {{nom}}'s identity verified. Third-party payment is now open for this patient.
IDENTITES.DOUBLONS_AVIS: These are not verdicts. No record is merged automatically: you decide, after looking. Merging two distinct people would mix their medical records — far worse than leaving a duplicate.
IDENTITES.DOUBLONS_PAS_OUTILLE: Merging two records is not built yet. Note both identifiers and report them to your facility administration.
IDENTITES.DOUBLONS_AUCUN: No similar record. That does not prove there is none: the search relies on the name, the phone number and the mother’s name, and a record with none of those known stays invisible.
IDENTITES.DOUBLONS_ERREUR: Similar records could not be loaded.
IDENTITES.TRAIT_NOM_PROCHE: One name contained in the other
IDENTITES.TRAIT_DATE_PAR_DEFAUT: Same date, but a default one (1 January)

IDENTITES.TRAIT_ORTHOGRAPHE_A_CONFIRMER: The name matches up to spelling: confirm against the ID document
IDENTITES.FUSION_SENS: {{absorbe}}'s record will join {{principal}}'s, which is kept.
IDENTITES.FUSION_AVIS: Everything attached to the absorbed record — consultations, vaccinations, appointments, invoices, contracts — joins the kept record. The absorbed record is not deleted: it keeps its QR code, so an old card still works.
IDENTITES.FUSION_AUDIT: The access journal is not moved: an access to the absorbed record remains an access to that record. Rewriting it would falsify a trace.
IDENTITES.FUSION_CONSENTEMENTS: Where the two records disagree on a consent, the more restrictive one wins. You will see which ones were restricted, so you can ask the patient again.
IDENTITES.FUSION_MOTIF: What are you basing this on?
IDENTITES.FUSION_MOTIF_AIDE: For example: "ID document presented, same number". This is what will make the merge contestable later.
IDENTITES.FUSION_FAITE: {{absorbe}} joined {{principal}}: {{n}} row(s) moved. The merge can be undone.
IDENTITES.FUSION_RESTREINTS: {{n}} consent(s) restricted: ask the patient again.
IDENTITES.FUSION_ERREUR: The merge could not be done.
IDENTITES.FUSION_ANNULER_AVIS: Every moved row will be returned to {{absorbe}}'s record. What was added to {{principal}} since the merge stays there.
IDENTITES.FUSION_ANNULEE_MSG: Merge undone. {{absorbe}} got back what belonged to it.
IDENTITES.FUSION_FAITE_VIDE: {{absorbe}} joined {{principal}}. The absorbed record carried no data to move — it is kept, its QR code now points to {{principal}}, and the merge can be undone.

FAQ.LEAD: Find clear answers about accounts, appointments, care follow-up and how your data is protected.

Q1.QUESTION: What is Baobao Health for?
Q1.ANSWER: Baobao Health supports care follow-up and helps patients and the professionals caring for them share relevant information.

Q2.QUESTION: Who can use the platform?
Q2.ANSWER: Patients and healthcare professionals can use spaces tailored to their roles, including doctors, reception teams, laboratories and pharmacies.

Q1.QUESTION: How do I create an account?
Q1.ANSWER: Choose “Create an account” and follow the steps shown. Registration uses an email address and a one-time verification code.

Q2.QUESTION: I forgot my password. What should I do?
Q2.ANSWER: On the sign-in page, choose “Forgot password” and follow the reset instructions sent to your email address.

Q1.QUESTION: How do I request an appointment?
Q1.ANSWER: You can submit a remote appointment request from your patient space. A request is not a confirmation: the doctor sets the time, and you are notified when it is scheduled.

Q2.QUESTION: Can I have a teleconsultation?
Q2.ANSWER: Teleconsultation is not currently available on the platform. Appointments and consultations follow the arrangements agreed with your healthcare professional.

Q3.QUESTION: When will my test results be visible?
Q3.ANSWER: Results appear in your patient space after they have been validated and approved by the doctor. They are not published automatically when entered by the laboratory.

Q4.QUESTION: Which documents can I find in my patient space?
Q4.ANSWER: Depending on the information recorded by your healthcare professionals, your space may show your record, appointments, prescriptions, vaccination record and test results.

Q1.QUESTION: I am a healthcare professional. Where can I learn more?
Q1.ANSWER: Visit the page for healthcare professionals to learn about the available spaces and how to access the platform.

Q1.QUESTION: How is my health data protected?
Q1.ANSWER: Access to information is limited by roles and permissions. The platform uses technical safeguards and keeps a record of access to patient files.

Q2.QUESTION: Where can I learn how my personal data is handled?
Q2.ANSWER: Visit Security & data for information about safeguards, and the Privacy Policy to learn how your data is used and managed.

FAQ.CONTACT_TEXT: Send us a message or find information for healthcare professionals.

PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy policy
PRIVACY.LEAD: How {{nom}} collects, uses and protects your personal and health data.

S1.TITLE: Data controller
S1.P1: The data controller is [Company name], publisher of {{nom}}, with registered office at [registered address]. For any question about your data, write to {{contact}}.

S2.TITLE: Data we collect
S2.P1: We only collect the data needed for your care:
S2.L1: Identity and contact details: last name, first name, phone number, and email address if you provide it.
S2.L2: Health data: consultations, vital signs, diagnoses, prescriptions, vaccinations and test results, entered by the professionals who care for you.
S2.L3: Technical data: history of sign-ins and of access to your record, required for security.

S3.TITLE: How your data is used
S3.P1: Your data is used only to:
S3.L1: ensure continuity of care between health workers, doctors, laboratories, hospitals and pharmacies;
S3.L2: let you view your record, your results and your prescriptions;
S3.L3: produce public health statistics, always anonymised.
S3.P2: It is never sold or used for advertising.

S4.TITLE: Consent and sharing
S4.P1: You decide who can access your record from the “Privacy & consents” area. Only authorised professionals, as part of your care, can view your data. Every access is recorded: you can see who opened your record, and when.

S5.TITLE: Retention period
S5.P1: Your data is kept for [legal retention period of the medical record], then deleted or anonymised.

S6.TITLE: Security
S6.P1: Sensitive medical data is encrypted, access is limited to each professional's role, and sign-in can be confirmed with a one-time code. The “Security & data” page describes these measures.

S7.TITLE: Your rights
S7.P1: Under Law L/2016/037/AN on cybersecurity and the protection of personal data, you have the following rights:
S7.L1: access your data and obtain a copy of your record;
S7.L3: object to processing and withdraw your consents at any time;
S7.L4: request deletion of your data, within the limits of legal retention obligations.
S7.P2: To exercise these rights, write to {{contact}}.

S8.TITLE: Changes to this policy
S8.P1: This policy may change. If there is a significant change, you will be informed in the application.

TERMS.TITLE: Terms of use
TERMS.LEAD: The rules for using {{nom}}, for patients and healthcare professionals alike.

S1.TITLE: Purpose
S1.P1: {{nom}} is a digital platform that connects patients, community health workers, doctors, laboratories, hospitals and pharmacies to follow the care pathway. These terms govern its use.

S2.TITLE: Medical emergencies
S2.P1: {{nom}} does not replace medical advice or emergency services. In an emergency, contact emergency services immediately or go to the nearest health facility.

S3.TITLE: Accounts and access
S3.P1: Patients create their own account. Professional accounts are created by their facility's administrator.
S3.L1: You are responsible for keeping your password and the codes you receive confidential.
S3.L2: Report any suspicious use of your account without delay.
S3.L3: The information you provide must be accurate and up to date.

S4.TITLE: Professionals' commitments
S4.P1: Healthcare professionals only access records to care for patients, in accordance with medical confidentiality. Every access is recorded.

S5.TITLE: Service availability
S5.P1: We do what is needed to keep the service available, including on low bandwidth and offline for field workers, without being able to guarantee uninterrupted operation.

S6.TITLE: Liability
S6.P1: Medical information entered is the responsibility of the professionals who enter it. [Company name] cannot be held liable for any use of the platform contrary to these terms.

S7.TITLE: Intellectual property
S7.P1: The platform, its brand and its content are protected. Any reproduction without permission is prohibited.

S8.TITLE: Governing law and contact
S8.P1: These terms are governed by Guinean law. For any question, write to {{contact}}.

SECURITY.LEAD: Health data is among the most sensitive there is. Here is, concretely, how {{nom}} protects it.

C1.TITLE: Sensitive data encrypted
C1.TEXT: Sensitive medical and personal information is encrypted in the database (AES-256-GCM): unreadable without the key, even if storage is accessed.

C2.TITLE: Passwords never in clear
C2.TEXT: Passwords are never stored as typed: they are transformed by a hashing algorithm (bcrypt) before being saved.

C3.TITLE: Verified sign-in
C3.TEXT: A sign-in can be confirmed with a 6-digit code sent by email, valid for a few minutes only.

C4.TITLE: Time-limited sessions
C4.TEXT: Sessions expire automatically: a forgotten device does not stay signed in forever.

C5.TITLE: Role-based access
C5.TEXT: Each professional only sees the information their job requires: a pharmacist does not see what a doctor sees.

C6.TITLE: Your consents
C6.TEXT: From your area, you decide who can view your record, and you can withdraw your consent at any time.

C7.TITLE: Access log
C7.TEXT: Every view of your record is recorded: you see who opened it, and when.

C8.TITLE: Built for the field
C8.TEXT: Health workers can work offline; data is synchronised as soon as the network returns.

SECURITY.RIGHTS_TEXT: Access, correction, withdrawal of consent: our privacy policy explains your rights and how to exercise them.

PROS.LEAD: {{nom}} supports every professional along the care pathway with a dedicated area, connected to the same patient record.

ASC.TITLE: Community health worker
ASC.TEXT: Local consultations, assisted triage, appointment planning, stock management and offline work with synchronisation.

MED.TITLE: Doctor
MED.TEXT: Consultation validation, prescription signing, referrals and messaging with field teams.

PHARMA.TITLE: Pharmacist
PHARMA.TEXT: Dispensing prescriptions by QR code or by number and verification code, and stock tracking.

LABO.TITLE: Laboratory
LABO.TEXT: Test request queue, entry and validation of results, alerts on critical values.

HOPITAL.TITLE: Hospital
HOPITAL.TEXT: Patient admission, care episodes, test requests and follow-up of critical results.

ADMIN.TITLE: Facility administration
ADMIN.TEXT: Management of staff and their access, facility settings and activity tracking.

PROS.JOIN_SUB: Professional accounts are created by the facility: nobody enters {{nom}} without being authorised.

E1.TITLE: Your facility contacts us
E1.TEXT: Health post or centre, hospital, laboratory or pharmacy: we register it on the platform.

E2.TITLE: The administrator creates accounts
E2.TEXT: Each professional receives an account with the role that matches their job.

E3.TITLE: Everyone signs in
E3.TEXT: From a computer or a phone, including on low bandwidth.

PROS.PANEL_TITLE: Security at the heart of every area
PROS.PANEL_TEXT: Role-limited access, encrypted sensitive data, every record view recorded.

ABOUT.LEAD: {{nom}} was born from a simple observation: a patient's record too often gets lost between the health post, the hospital, the laboratory and the pharmacy.
ABOUT.PROBLEM: Lost paper booklets, repeated tests, illegible prescriptions, patients retelling their history to every caregiver: continuity of care still too often depends on chance.
ABOUT.MISSION: One record that follows every patient, everywhere, online and offline, so that every caregiver has the right information at the right time. That is why {{nom}} exists.

V1.TITLE: Built for the field
V1.TEXT: Low bandwidth, network outages, modest phones: every screen is designed for real conditions.

V2.TITLE: Trust and privacy
V2.TEXT: Patients stay in control of their record; access is limited, recorded and encrypted.

V3.TITLE: A pathway, not silos
V3.TEXT: Health workers, doctors, laboratories, hospitals and pharmacies work on the same record.

V4.TITLE: Made in Guinea
V4.TEXT: Built in Guinea, with and for Guinean healthcare professionals.

AGREMENT.SECTION_NOTE: Required for a private facility. Creation is refused while the file is incomplete.
AGREMENT.RCCM_HINT: The trade register entry (APIP). It identifies the company; it authorises no health activity.
AGREMENT.LIEU_PH: Neighbourhood, commune, prefecture as written on the order
AGREMENT.LIEU_HINT: As written on the licence. A gap with the real address is exactly what an inspection penalises.
AGREMENT.EXPLOITATION_HINT: Separate from the creation licence: inspections ask for both.
AGREMENT.BCRG_HINT: Insurance is supervised by the Central Bank, not the Ministry of Health: one reference, no separate operating order.
AGREMENT.ERR_IDENTIFIANTS: Fill in the RCCM, the authorised location and the licence numbers before creating.
AGREMENT.ERR_PIECES: Attach every required document before creating.

PIECE.AIDE: Each document must be a PDF of at most 5 MB. Files stay private: only the administration and the facility itself can open them.
PIECE.PAS_UN_PDF: This file is not a PDF.
PIECE.AGREMENT_CREATION_AIDE: The order authorising the facility's creation.
PIECE.AGREMENT_EXPLOITATION_AIDE: The order authorising operation. Separate from the creation one.
PIECE.DIPLOME_RESPONSABLE_AIDE: Certified. Pharmacist, doctor or biologist depending on the facility type.
PIECE.INSCRIPTION_ORDRE_AIDE: The certificate of registration with the relevant professional order.
PIECE.AGREMENT_ASSURANCE_AIDE: The licence decision issued by the BCRG for the lines of business carried.
PIECE.AUTRE_AIDE: Any other document the relevant directorate asks for.

DOSSIER.RIEN_A_FOURNIR: This facility has no private licence to produce.
DOSSIER.LIBELLE_REQUIS: Name the document before attaching it: without a label it would be unreadable in the list.
DOSSIER.AJOUT_AIDE: For any document the relevant directorate asks for that is not listed above.
DOSSIER.SANS_STRUCTURE: Your account is not attached to any facility: there is no file to keep.
